name: com.harness.bridge
description: The agent harness's link into Unity: a localhost-only, token-protected editor bridge (scene, GameObjects, components, prefabs, scripts, play mode, captures, the console), batch entry points for -executeMethod (level building, imports, captures, tests, builds, play sessions, project descriptions) and a small runtime (input injection, game state, playback with frames and metrics, the AI player's step mode). Installed by the harness into Packages/; safe to remove.
